about_item: Orthopedic Support: The dual-layer, high-density memory foam dog crate mat designed gives your pet optimal support. A soft memory foam top layer combines with a supportive bottom layer to help distribute weight evenly and relieve pressure on joints. ( Not recommended for pets with chewing behavior!!!)
Easy Care Removable Washable Cover: Bedsure's orthopedic dog bed features an easy-to-remove zippered washable cover that makes deep cleaning a breeze. Simply machine wash and tumble dry.

Pet Safe Materials & Non-Slip Base: CertiPUR-US certified foam and luxurious flannel come together to create a dog bed that is as safe as it is comfortable. The non-skid bottom reduces slips, keeping your dog's joints safe.

Various Sizes: Available in 4 sizes for all dog breeds. S size 24×16×3" for dogs up to 20 lbs like Miniature Schnauzers and Pomeranians; M size 29×18×3" for dogs 20-30 lbs like Beagles and French Bulldogs; L size 35×22×3" for dogs 30-50 lbs like Border Collies and Corgis; XL size 41×29×3.5" for dogs 50-90 lbs like Labradors and Pitbulls.

Versatile Design: Ideal for use at home and on the go as a crate bed or pillow in your car, at a hotel, or wherever life takes you. Easily movable and portable. Features a minimalist design that will fit seamlessly with any decor.

authors_reviews.title: Love this bed! Great quality at a good price! Looks good and nice dense foam for dog's comfort
authors_reviews.text: I love this bed!! It looks great and feels great, and a good price for this quality! The foam feels like it will hold up for a long time. The washable cover is well made and fits the foam cushion nicely, it looks very tailored. The foam is nice & dense for a comfortable place to sleep or just hang out. Also good for aging dogs & achy joints, no uncomfortable pressure points to worry about. The large size can fit our two 25-30 lb dogs if they curl up side by side, but I bought an extra one to give them more room to spread out. I read a few other reviews where they said it took awhile for the foam to spring into shape after shipping, but I didn't have this problem at all. My 2 beds were ordered a few months apart and I had the same good experience with both of them. Mine did arrive all scrunched up in a small box for shipping, but they puffed up within probably an hour or less.

authors_reviews.title: Super comfy, durable! The first-ever pet bed that keeps in one piece and never shrinks when washed!
authors_reviews.text: The Bedsure Memory Foam Dog Bed is a fantastic product.MEMORY FOAM MATTRESS itself has 2 parts being the blue one the actual memory foam. Our pup simply loves his bed, which sits inside his crate, and will many times during day lay down for naps. The mattress is very comfortable!LIQUID-PROOF COVER For starters, the memory foam mattress has the liquid-proof zippered cover which when accidents happen, will NOT sold the foam mattress and can easily be wiped clean.This zippered cover is a perfect fit for the mattress, not too stretched not oversized.OUTSIDE FABRIC COVER is also very soft and comfortable. Accidents happen and when they do, all it takes is to throw it in the washer, then dryer and in a few minutes, it's back to new. Before this one, every mattress cover we've ever washed comes out of the dryer shrunk, smaller and more difficult to slip back on. Not this one! Every wash and dry it comes out just like when it was brand new, easy to fit, easy to zip and wash.We highly recommend the Bedsure Memory Foam Dog Bed wether as a standalone bed for your pet or as a bed for our pup's crate. This is our 2nd purchase, both holding up remarkably.
authors_reviews.author: Bullseye

authors_reviews.title: Very nice dog bed - but they don't supply the waterproof inner liner any more
authors_reviews.text: UPDATE: Bedsure was very quick to respond to my complaint in a fair manner. They thoroughly explained the upgrade to the item. This changed my rating from a "1" to a "4." Excellent customer service.I purchased two of these beds in the past month.The first one I bought was a used bed with no issues. It came with the inner memory foam (blue cooling on one side and egg-crate white foam on the other,) the cover, and an inner waterproof zippered protector for the memory foam.The second one I bought came with the same excluding the inner waterproof zippered protector.Expecting the liner, I contacted BedSure and they said it was due to "product iteration." They also explained "In theory, it protects your mattress from various types of stains and to keep water automatically roll down. However in our lab test, the liquid is always to be handled with very soon. So the result comes out no problem.In practical application, we are also expected to deal with the liquid in time. If keep it there for a long time, it is possible that it will gradually penetrate, due to only one layer of waterproof material on the surface."So...if the dog has an accident overnight while the family is sleeping it could easily ruin the memory foam, which is not washable.Not pleased with this changed. If something does happen, I will be looking for an alternative bed that comes with an inner waterproof liner elsewhere.

authors_reviews.title: Nice bed for two kittens
authors_reviews.text: Purchased this bed because I had a small footrest under my desk that my kittens fought to sleep on. I needed something larger with firm memory foam that would also be good for my feet and for my cats spines; this bed did the trick. The kitties also needed something with a cooler fabric temperature (my cats strongly dislike plush and Sherpa for sleeping). This is not plushy... it's more flat and silky.Pros:- exact size as described- soft material that's cool to touch- two layers of memory foam, not egg carton shaped- 3 inches thick, so it doesn't sink easily with two cats in the same spot- removable cover, easy to get on/off- no strong scent when first opened-came packed well, clean/new, shipping was on time and handled carefullyCons:- it came wrapped tightly, as most memory foam products do, but it did take a few hours to fully expand and firm up. Had to step on it every now and again because there was a bend in the center that took a while to flatten out. Not really a big deal to me, but it might be to other people.- there is an anti-slip bottom, it does work well but sometimes the bed does shift with quick motions, so I wouldn't necessarily say it's going to stay perfectly in place if you have animals running/jumping on it.- it is 3 inches of memory foam which is perfect for our use of it, but I don't think this is firm enough for anyone needing a stiffer type of memory foam. This bed is more on the medium-soft to soft side, and it will likely sink easily with heavier animals. I barely put my weight on it while moving some things around and my hand went straight to the floor squishing the foam. Again, this doesn't bother me because my kittens are lightweight and in good health, and I don't notice any serious dips in the material when they lay on it, but it could be an issue for anyone with heavier pets requiring stiffer beds for orthopedic or post-surgery needs. Just a thought.
authors_reviews.author: Domino
